name: Near and Far

categories.label: Placed camps
categories.hint: 1 per camp on the map, mine or a threat card.

categories.label: Completed trade routes
categories.hint: Points printed atop the map: larger if you alone own it, smaller if shared. Incomplete route = 0.

categories.label: Purchased artifacts
categories.hint: Journey points in the top-left corner of each purchased artifact.

categories.label: Unpurchased artifacts in hand
categories.labelVi: Cổ vật chưa mua trong tay
categories.hint: -1 per artifact card still in hand.

categories.label: Defeated threats
categories.hint: Points on top of each threat card you defeated.

categories.label: Other card bonuses
categories.hint: Bonus conditions printed on artifact/treasure/world cards, plus talents (e.g. Storytelling +2 for highest reputation).

categories.label: Reputation track position
categories.hint: Reputation at game end: 4-5=2, 6-7=3, 8-9=4, continuing +1 per 2 (track max 12). Below 4 not stated = 0. Only one value counts.

categories.label: All camps removed from player board
categories.labelVi: Dùng hết trại trên bảng người chơi
categories.hint: +2 if you removed all your camps from the player board.

categories.label: Own 3 treasure cards
categories.hint: +5 if you own 3 treasure cards at game end (a treasure kept aside without pack bird via Scrounging does not count).

categories.label: Coins and gems (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Xu và đá quý (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: Highest reputation (unless a card power says otherwise)

notes: family: end-game-categories. Verified vs official rulebook printed p.28. Game end triggers when a player places their 14th camp; finish the round. Reputation track: only 4-5=2, 6-7=3, 8-9=4 'etc.' are printed; 10-12 follow the pattern and values below 4 are treated as 0 (not stated). Advanced Town (Day) board only: reputation -3/-4 = -1, -5/-6 = -2 (not modelled in base). Tie: highest reputation (a card power overrides), then most coins/gems. Campaign, Character and solo modes only sum per-game scores; not modelled.

sources.title: Near and Far Rulebook (Red Raven Games)
sources.section: printed p.28 Game End (journey points, tiebreakers); p.36 Advanced Town reputation penalty
